evidence_candidates.excerpt: The CXL Consortium's public release says CXL 4.0 doubles link bandwidth to 128 GT/s, adds bundled ports and memory RAS enhancements, and retains backward compatibility for open coherent interconnection of heterogeneous memory and computing devices.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: CXL and UCIe standards are extending open interconnects for higher-bandwidth heterogeneous memory, compute and multi-chiplet systems while retaining interoperability mechanisms.
